2608.28270.title: Spatial-Semantic Reasoning using Large Language Models for Efficient UAV Search Operations
2608.28270.paper_summary: We present a real-time semantic navigation framework for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) focused on improving time efficiency in the Object Goal Navigation (ObjectNav) task. Central to our approach is a Large Language Model (LLM) that interprets user-provided natural language instructions and performs semantic reasoning over detected objects and spatial context to prioritize high-probability search regions. The system combines real-time object detection, 3D spatial mapping, and polynomial spline interpolation for smooth and feasible UAV trajectory planning. Unlike prior methods that rely on offline reasoning or simulator-constrained action spaces, our framework can operate in real time, continuously updating semantic relevance based on new observations. Experiments in both simulated and real-world settings demonstrate reductions in mission duration while maintaining high search accuracy, underscoring the effectiveness of LLM-guided reasoning for time- efficient UAV-based ObjectNav.
2608.28270.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了一個針對無人機 (UAV) 的實時語義導航框架，專注於提高物體目標導航 (ObjectNav) 任務的時間效率。<lb/>我們的方法的核心是一個大型語言模型 (LLM)，它解釋用戶提供的自然語言指令，並對檢測到的物體和空間上下文進行語義推理，以優先考慮高概率的搜索區域。<lb/>該系統結合了實時物體檢測、3D 空間映射和多項式樣條插值，以實現平滑且可行的無人機軌跡規劃。<lb/>與依賴離線推理或模擬器限制行動空間的先前方法不同，我們的框架可以實時運行，根據新觀察不斷更新語義相關性。<lb/>在模擬和現實世界環境中的實驗顯示，任務持續時間有所縮短，同時保持高搜索準確性，突顯了 LLM 引導推理在時間效率無人機基於 ObjectNav 中的有效性。
